# GeoTrivia Atlas — Full Knowledge Directory (LLM Context Feed)
Website: https://atlas.geotriviax.com
Total Indexed Topics: 9,473 Clean Wikipedia Verified Entities
Languages Supported: English (en), Spanish (es), French (fr), German (de), Portuguese (pt), Italian (it), Dutch (nl), Swedish (sv), Turkish (tr), Arabic (ar)

## Category Breakdown & Canonical Topics

### 1. Geographic Paradoxes (Category: paradoxes)
- Total Topics: 701
- Focus: Enclaves, exclaves, condominiums, tripoints, counter-enclaves, sovereignty rotation.
- Canonical Examples:
  * Baarle-Nassau & Baarle-Hertog (Netherlands/Belgium): 22 Belgian exclaves nested inside Dutch territory, governed by the "Front Door Rule" (Voordeurregel). URL: https://atlas.geotriviax.com/baarle-nassau-border-paradox
  * Pheasant Island (France/Spain): Joint condominium on Bidasoa River rotating sovereignty every 6 months by Treaty of the Pyrenees (1659).
  * Llívia (Spain/France): Spanish municipality completely surrounded by French territory of Pyrénées-Orientales.
  * Büsingen am Hochrhein (Germany/Switzerland): German town surrounded by Swiss cantons, using Swiss Franc and dual postcodes.
  * Campione d'Italia (Italy/Switzerland): Italian enclave inside Swiss Ticino.

### 2. Ghost Towns & Ruins (Category: abandoned)
- Total Topics: 270
- Focus: Post-disaster exclusion zones, resource depletion ruins, desertified settlements.
- Canonical Examples:
  * Pripyat (Ukraine): Chernobyl exclusion zone, abandoned April 1986.
  * Hashima Island / Gunkanjima (Japan): Concrete coal mining island in Nagasaki prefecture abandoned in 1974.
  * Kolmanskop (Namibia): German diamond boom town swallowed by Namib desert dunes.
  * Centralia, Pennsylvania (USA): Coal seam fire burning beneath streets since 1962.
  * Craco (Italy): Medieval hilltop village abandoned due to landslides.

### 3. Earth Extremes (Category: extremes)
- Total Topics: 1,213
- Focus: Deepest trenches, highest peaks, coldest/hottest inhabited places, absolute isolation.
- Canonical Examples:
  * Point Nemo (South Pacific): Oceanic Pole of Inaccessibility, 2,688 km from nearest land.
  * Challenger Deep (Mariana Trench): Ocean floor at 10,928 meters depth.
  * Oymyakon & Verkhoyansk (Siberia, Russia): Coldest permanently inhabited places (-67.7°C recorded).
  * Danakil Depression (Ethiopia): Lowest and hottest geological furnace on Earth with active hydrothermal chimneys.
  * Mount Chimborazo (Ecuador): Closest point on Earth's surface to the sun due to equatorial bulge.

### 4. Borders & Frontiers (Category: borders)
- Total Topics: 936
- Focus: Demilitarized zones, border barriers, treaty boundary markers, international crossing points.
- Canonical Examples:
  * Korean Demilitarized Zone (DMZ): 250 km border corridor along 38th parallel.
  * India–Bangladesh Enclaves (historic Chitmahals): 162 enclaves exchanged in 2015 Land Boundary Agreement.
  * Haskell Free Library and Opera House (USA/Canada border): Deliberately built straddling the international boundary in Derby Line, VT / Stanstead, QC.
  * Diomede Islands (USA/Russia): Big Diomede (Russia) and Little Diomede (USA) separated by 3.8 km and 21 hours (International Date Line).

### 5. Earth Enigmas (Category: enigmas)
- Total Topics: 462
- Focus: Geoglyphs, impact craters, megalithic alignments, geological anomalies.
- Canonical Examples:
  * Richat Structure / Eye of the Sahara (Mauritania): 40-km circular geological dome in the Sahara.
  * Nazca Lines (Peru): Vast desert geoglyphs created between 500 BCE and 500 CE.
  * Göbekli Tepe (Turkey): World's oldest known megalithic temple sanctuary (c. 9500 BCE).
  * Darvaza Gas Crater / Door to Hell (Turkmenistan): Natural gas crater ignited in 1971 burning continuously.

### 6. World Landmarks (Category: world-landmarks)
- Total Topics: 865
- Focus: Iconic civil engineering, historical monuments, world heritage landmarks.
- Canonical Examples:
  * Angkor Wat (Cambodia): Largest religious structure in the world.
  * Great Pyramid of Giza (Egypt): Oldest of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
  * Taj Mahal (India): 17th-century Mughal white marble mausoleum.
  * Colosseum (Italy): Flavian amphitheatre in Rome.

### 7. Castles & Palaces (Category: castles-and-palaces)
- Total Topics: 1,032
- Focus: Fortresses, imperial palaces, defensive citadels.
- Canonical Examples:
  * Alhambra (Spain): Nasrid dynasty fortified palace in Granada.
  * Neuschwanstein Castle (Germany): 19th-century Romanesque Revival palace in Bavaria.
  * Himeji Castle (Japan): White Heron castle with advanced feudal defensive systems.
  * Edinburgh Castle (Scotland): Historic fortress dominating Castle Rock.

### 8. Cities & Capitals (Category: cities-and-capitals)
- Total Topics: 721
- Focus: Divided cities, historic capitals, geographic administrative anomalies.
- Canonical Examples:
  * Nicosia (Cyprus): Last divided capital in the world with UN Buffer Zone (Green Line).
  * Gorizia / Nova Gorica (Italy/Slovenia): Post-WWII divided twin cities.
  * Brasília (Brazil): UNESCO-listed planned modernist national capital (1960).
  * Naypyidaw (Myanmar): Planned 2005 capital city with 20-lane highways.

### 9. Natural Wonders (Category: natural-wonders)
- Total Topics: 720
- Focus: Waterfalls, canyons, karsts, volcanic phenomena.
- Canonical Examples:
  * Salar de Uyuni (Bolivia): World's largest salt flat (10,582 sq km).
  * Iguazu Falls (Argentina/Brazil): Semi-circular waterfall system of 275 drops.
  * Catatumbo Lightning (Lake Maracaibo, Venezuela): Atmospheric phenomenon producing 250 lightning flashes per hour.
  * Boiling River / Shanay-Timpishka (Peru): Geothermally heated tributary of Amazon reaching 100°C.

### 10. Street View & Routes (Category: street-view-and-discovery)
- Total Topics: 357
- Focus: Extreme mountain passes, trans-continental highways, scenic routes.
- Canonical Examples:
  * Stelvio Pass (Italy): 48 hairpin turns reaching 2,757 meters in the Eastern Alps.
  * Guoliang Tunnel (China): 1.2 km cliffside tunnel hand-carved through Taihang Mountains.
  * Transfăgărășan (Romania): High-altitude military road traversing Southern Carpathians.
  * Atlantic Ocean Road (Norway): Arching road spanning archipelago islands over the Norwegian Sea.

### 11. Countries & Territories (Category: countries-and-territories)
- Total Topics: 274
- Focus: 193 UN member states, 2 UN observers (Vatican, Palestine), 55 official dependent/overseas territories, Crown Dependencies, limited recognition states.

### 12. Flags & Symbols (Category: flags-and-symbols)
- Total Topics: 507
- Focus: Vexillology, heraldry, proportion mathematics (e.g. Nepal's non-quadrilateral flag).

### 13. Culture & Arts (Category: culture-and-arts)
- Total Topics: 267
- Focus: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity, traditional festivals, gastronomy.

### 14. History & Civilization (Category: history-and-civilization)
- Total Topics: 891
- Focus: Lost cities, ancient trade routes (Silk Road, Amber Road), historical empires.

### 15. Rankings & Indices (Category: rankings)
- Total Topics: 83
- Focus: Global benchmark indices (Human Development Index, World Happiness Report, Democracy Index).

### 16. Indigenous Peoples (Category: indigenous)
- Total Topics: 122
- Focus: Uncontacted tribes (Sentinelese, Korubo, Flecheiros), nomadic pastoralists, ancestral communities.

### 17. Micronations (Category: micronations)
- Total Topics: 52
- Focus: Principality of Sealand, Hutt River, Liberland, Republic of Molossia.
